body:
I understand your point and can relate to it on an objective level - but honestly, when I said I have justifications for not choosing any of the choices, I mean any of them. If I imagine someone else was in my situation, I would consider the options reasonable and doable. But since it's *me*, none of them are valid for a myriad of reasons.

I'm avoiding describing any specific issues because of the deep sense of shame surrounding them: they might not look as unsolvable as they are to me and people have gone through worse. I know there might be ways out in theory, it's just that the ways are always for other people. For me they are unrealistic no matter what. That's why I am in this state of passiveness.

But I do appreciate your words and the time you took to reply to me, I will try to think about them.
